mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire format

The project's current recorded decision is to use CBOR as the wire serialisation format, chosen for its better type safety and because it handles our schema better.

cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says the current recorded decision is CBOR as the wire serialisation format, chosen for better type safety and a better fit with the schema. The doc doesn't mention the retired alternative.

The first attempt, a shell heredoc, failed with a parser error, so I wrote the file with the Write tool instead.
